title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 18. Notes the Ombudsman’s commitment to fundamental rights; notes that the Ombudsman asked for greater transparency with regard to the human rights information considered before signing the EU-Tunisia Memorandum of Understanding (MoU); recalls the Ombudsman’s concerns about the absence of a prior human rights impact assessment, in particular as regards the ‘Migration and mobility’ pillar of the MoU; calls on the Commission to implement the Ombudsman’s suggestions for improvement in a timely manner and to uphold the highest standards of human rights protection in all migration-related matters;
